arguments.hindsight: I should have grasped the car and shoe nearer their centres of mass, verified stable lifts before transporting them, and obtained an unobstructed side view of the box rim before approaching. The box needed stabilization or repositioning immediately after its first displacement.
arguments.reason: I could not complete controlled placements. The car repeatedly slipped, and contact displaced the box beyond the insertion poses I could reach reliably. The held shoe has been released onto the table.
